  The current shellcheck lint silently ignores all files with a shell shebang that are not ending in `.sh`.

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36867: test: remove legacy wallet leftovers from wallet functional tests

b9b33544aaf17d47d27f7393d3e21d6ff8f93485 test: remove no-op -keypool=0 from wallet_hd (w0xlt)
1ac0e9cd5b02db659774ff70a055ced0572b5420 test: update wallet_backup docstring (w0xlt)
363355a72dc159783a7113f721ff1c718de0c8f6 test: remove dead multisig code from wallet_address_types (w0xlt)

Pull request description:

  This PR cleans up three tests that still carry code or text from the legacy wallet:

  - `wallet_address_types.py`: the send loop iterates over `do_multisigs = [False]`, so its multisig code path and the multisig cases of `test_address`/`test_desc` can't run. That code path is also broken, since it never sets the address it checks. This PR removes that code, along with the docstring section about the old `addmultisigaddress` tests.

  - `wallet_backup.py`: the docstring still describes `dumpwallet`/`importwallet` and erasing wallets; the test uses `backupwallet` and `restorewallet`.

  - `wallet_hd.py`: `-keypool=0` does nothing for descriptor wallets, which always keep at least one key, and the test config already sets `keypool=1`.

  No coverage changes: `wallet_address_types.py` runs the same 8 send iterations before and after.

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36864: rpc: deprecate iswatchonly field of getaddressinfo

5b2f979c9e474a641b90902c3a87dee93c8f2899 doc: add release note for getaddressinfo iswatchonly deprecation (w0xlt)
375dc869d8bd444f7485ab0c030d793063d91a06 rpc: deprecate iswatchonly field of getaddressinfo (w0xlt)

Pull request description:

  Since #32618, `getaddressinfo` returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. It was kept and marked "(DEPRECATED)" so it could be removed later without surprising users ([review comment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32618#discussion_r2180720302)), but it was never put behind `-deprecatedrpc`. The v30 release notes also say it was already removed from all RPCs, which isn't true for `getaddressinfo`.

  This returns it only with `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly`, like `startingheight` in `getpeerinfo` (#34197), so it can be removed in the next release.

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36889: cmake: Switch `include_directories` -> `target_include_directories`

435d5b227748a0ac5d6d2887050acf02304576f2 cmake: Remove `WarnAboutGlobalProperties` module (Hennadii Stepanov)
460f877fac200ccfde265d12613b352def903cf0 cmake: Switch `include_directories` -> `target_include_directories` (Hennadii Stepanov)
4ef05d6f45620254417fe6be701bebbf1a42619a cmake: Link `bitcoin_ipc` against `core_interface` (Hennadii Stepanov)

Pull request description:

  Use of non-target directives is not recommended. As of CMake 4.5.0, such use triggers `-Wnon-target-directive` warnings:
  ```console
  $ cmake -B build -Wnon-target-directive
  <snip>
  CMake Warning (non-target-directive) at src/CMakeLists.txt:8 (include_directories):
    Use of non-target directives is not recommended.  Consider
    target_include_directories instead.
  This warning is for project developers.  Use -Wno-author or
  -Wno-non-target-directive to suppress it.

  <snip>
  ```

  This PR:
  1. Links `bitcoin_ipc` against `core_interface`, so that `ipc/stub.cpp` is compiled with the project-wide build flags.

  2. Replaces the `include_directories()` call in `src/CMakeLists.txt` with `target_include_directories()`.

  3. Removes the custom [`WarnAboutGlobalProperties`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/29f7e30d547c30ddb7a637bc3a2dbc7c0e3f5469/cmake/module/WarnAboutGlobalProperties.cmake) module, which is superseded by the new CMake warning.

  ---

  The counterpart for the `secp256k1` repo is https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1996.

    ACK 435d5b227748a0ac5d6d2887050acf02304576f2 - going to merge this now, given it was mentioned on IRC that devs are seeing local build breakage (after updating CMake).

commit.message:
Merge bitcoin/bitcoin#36894: net_processing: set fDisconnect instead of calling DisconnectNode

d63068c58ec9fcc94876bce30865d1a7266d64d4 net_processing: set fDisconnect instead of calling DisconnectNode (Eugene Siegel)

Pull request description:

  `MaybeDiscourageAndDisconnect` calls `DisconnectNode` which creates a `CSubNet` containing only the `CNode`'s address. This will disconnect every `CNode` with the same IP address. This is normally not a problem, except for clearnet-over-tor. If a node has an honest clearnet-over-tor inbound connection, the IP of the inbound peer will be the exit node's IP address. If an attacker connects to the node through the same exit node and sends an invalid message, they can cause every inbound peer sharing the exit node's IP to get disconnected. Fix this by only disconnecting the misbehaving `CNode` rather than every `CNode` sharing the IP.

CSubNet containing only the CNode's address. This will disconnect
every CNode with the same IP address. This is normally not a problem,
except for clearnet-over-tor. If a node has an honest clearnet-over-tor
inbound connection, the IP of the inbound peer will be the exit node's
IP address. If an attacker connects to the node through the same exit
node and sends an invalid message, they can cause every inbound peer
sharing the exit node's IP to get disconnect. Fix this by only
disconnecting the misbehaving CNode rather than every CNode sharing
the IP.

commit.message:
test: remove no-op -keypool=0 from wallet_hd

Descriptor wallets always keep a keypool of at least 1, and the
functional test configuration already sets keypool=1, so -keypool=0
does not change anything for node1.

test: update wallet_backup docstring

The docstring still describes backing up with dumpwallet, erasing the
wallets and restoring with importwallet. The test now backs up with
backupwallet and restores the backups on the miner with restorewallet.

test: remove dead multisig code from wallet_address_types

The send loop runs over do_multisigs = [False], so multisig is always
false. True was only added for legacy wallets (59d3da5bce), and that
was removed together with the legacy wallet tests in c847dee148.

Remove the multisig loop dimension, the unreachable multisig code path,
which has not set the address it then checks since fe838dd391, and the
multisig cases of test_address and test_desc. Also drop the docstring
section about the removed addmultisigaddress tests, correct the senders
to node0-node3, and fix the "N/101th" fractions in the same list.
